description: Election Commission - Mr. Soolanga Arachchige Thamity Nihal Dias of the Peliyagoda Urban Council has Vacated his Office of member
reasoning: This gazette notice declares a vacancy in a local authority (Peliyagoda Urban Council) due to a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This is a notice issued under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance by a Returning Officer and directly concerns the composition of an elected body, making it an electoral process matter that fits Type 7 (Elections).
